reader.requirement: At --std 85 literal-1 of a report file's ASSIGN clause must be a nonnumeric literal that is not a figurative constant: a numeric literal and every figurative constant (SPACE, ZERO, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUES, ALL literal) are refused, while a nonnumeric literal and an implementor-name (with the implementor's rules for their content) are accepted.

edition-consulted.switches: sortMerge1985 (kind SortMerge and DialectLevel < 2002) suppresses the deferred numeric/figurative findings for a 1985 SD entry only; a report file is not sort-merge, so the findings are reported as at 2023

reader.edition-search: AssignTargetRule.Text records the numeric-literal and figurative-constant findings on FileModel.EntryShapeFindings and reports the non-alphanumeric/zero-length ones directly; the only edition read is in Screen (sortMerge1985).
